programmes.d: Martin and Lucy view a semi in County Durham, a garage in Devon and a 1930s flat in South London.
Martin and Lucy visit properties in Essex, Devon and Croydon.
Martin and Lucy visit a three bed semi in Nottinghamshire, in Reading there's a tiny plot in a peaceful location and not all it seems to be in a three bedroomed house in Cardiff.

Lucy Alexander and Martin Roberts see a semi-detached property in Ilford in Essex; a three bedroom, ex-miner's cottage in the Welsh town of Cwmparc in the Rhondda Valley; and an old Blacksmith's shop in the beautiful Dorset village of Puncknowle.
Martin and Lucy visit a 4 floor property in Southampton, a house in Hartlepool in need of an electrician and a top floor flat in London.
Martin and Lucy visit a mid terraced house in Stoke-on-Trent, an old health spa in Kent and revisit an old Chapel in Nottinghamshire over two years since we first visited it.

Lucy & Martin travel to Folkestone to see a Victorian house that could offer someone a foot on the property ladder. Then it's on to Hertfordshire to see a 3 bed terrace and in Devon there's an old inn up for sale where last orders have been called.
Martin and Lucy visit a house in Barnet, a property in Derbyshire that has undergone some huge changes and a plot of land in Wiltshire.
Martin and Lucy visit properties in Liverpool, Cornwall and Hartlepool.
Martin & Lucy visit a bungalow in Consett, County Durham, a property in Canterbury, Kent and a house in Staffordshire.

Lucy and Martin visit a three bedroom house in Essex with unusual features, a roomy flat in Battersea, South London, and an end of terrace house in Liverpool. We see what happens when they go under the hammer!
Martin Roberts and Lucy Alexander look at a cottage in Cheshire and a flat in Stoke.
Martin & Lucy visit a bungalow in Lincolnshire, a maisonette in Buckinghamshire and a three story house in Nottingham.
Martin and Lucy visit a pleasantly surprising terrace in Cheshire, a large flat in London with great views and a house in Torquay.
Lucy Alexander and Martin Roberts visit a forgotten building in Lancashire, a 1930s house in Derbyshire and a workshop in Devon.
Martin & Lucy visit a property in Timperley, near Manchester, a south London flat and a bungalow on the edge of the Peak District.
Martin and Lucy view a little house in London, an investment property in Devon and commercial premises in Kent.
Martin and Lucy visit a house in Derby, a house in Portsmouth and a two bedroom flat in Leeds.
Martin Roberts and Lucy Alexander visit properties in Wiltshire, Liverpool and Norwich.

Lucy Alexander and Martin Roberts travel to Cornwall to see a beautiful Cornish cottage; then on to Derby to see a run down home turn into a love nest. With no price guide; a derelict 'house' in Lancashire that someone has waited 25 years to buy!
Martin & Lucy visit a terraced house in Derby, a property in Kent and a cottage in rural Devon.
